question: At the transition described by footnotes *10 and *11, on which calendar date(s) during Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30) does the Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase 30-day average limit switch from 27,664 lbs/day (497 mg/L) to 24,992 lbs/day (449 mg/L)?
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf page 5 section part_i (Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase rows marked *10 and *11; footnotes *10 and *11)
semantic_arguments: Permit effective date is December 1, 2021; expiration is November 30, 2026.
Footnote *10 states the 27,664 lbs/day limit begins on the effective date and lasts 'through 3 years from the permit effective date.'
Footnote *11 states the 24,992 lbs/day limit applies 'during the period beginning 3 year from the permit effective date' through expiration (and administrative continuation).
Federal FY2025 spans October 1, 2024 through September 30, 2025, which includes the three-year anniversary of the effective date.
Different readings of 'through 3 years from' versus 'beginning 3 year from' could assign different limits to measurements taken in late 2024 and early 2025.
notes: The passage pairs two distinct numeric limits with temporally scoped footnotes whose boundary phrasing is not explicitly inclusive or exclusive; resolving the transition date is required before comparing FY2025 measurements to the applicable limit.
